messages:
alina: Planning a soft launch for slate-v2 in EU tonight 23:00 UTC. Traffic plan: 5% canary -> 20% at +30m -> full at +2h. Need ops + eng acks and any pin overrides.

matt: eng ack. perf checks on dev look good; quant profile stable.

sarah: SRE ack. I'll monitor p95 and 5xx. Rollback if p95 >2x baseline or errors >1.5% sustained for 30m.

jordan: Confirming fallback order? current is slate->harbor->default.

alina: For rollout, prefer slate-v2 then harbor-13b then sentinel-quant. No TTL changes.

matt: adding a temporary support-tier pin: route support users to harbor if extra p95 >100ms. Will add to catalog.

sarah: include that in release note blob for ops-bot.

deploy-bot: queued enable slate-v2 (eu) by alina for 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary 5%. Preflight: signature OK, quant loaded, kv warmup scheduled.

alina: ops-bot set rollback hook: error_rate>1.5% OR p95>2x over 30m. Auto-fallback to harbor-13b-eu.

ops-bot: rollback hook saved. auto-fallback target harbor-13b-eu. Pages after 3 eval windows.

matt: canary cap 400 rps. If queue growth >20% throttle to 2% and notify.

sarah: deploying synthetic probes (seq 128,512; chat/completion; qps 10) in 10m.

jordan: request: manual short-circuit pin for premium customers to last-stable on hallucination regressions.

alina: agreed. manual premium pin requires two approvers (alina + matt). Add to escalation.

matt: release note: "soft enable slate-v2 (EU) 5%->20%->full. Fallback: harbor-13b, sentinel-quant. Rollback: errors>1.5% or p95>2x for 30m. Premium manual pin (2 approvers)."

sarah: will post status at +15m, +45m, +2h and page if issues.

deploy-bot: scheduled: slate-v2 enable in 35m. Will post when canary goes live.

alina: thanks all. keep chatter minimal during window; call @sarah @matt for immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
